title: Partition configuration
description: docs/partition.yml of a project that uses the Partition package. budget.mjs checks the file against this schema.

version.description: The version of this file's format.

target.description: Whose loading rules the gauges follow.

bridge.description: none, or superpowers: the Superpowers plugin writes the body of each plan. The folder of the plans is paths.plans.

specs.description: The folder of the durable specs. Default docs/specs.

plans.description: The folder of the plans. Default docs/plans.

contracts.description: The default folder where a pasted contract, or one read from a URL, is saved; a contract elsewhere in the repository is read where it lives. Default docs/contracts.

sources.description: The default folder where a pasted or described source (a PRD, a described context) is saved, decomposed by partition-shape; a source elsewhere in the repository, a spec written before Partition included, is read where it lives. Default docs/sources.

schemas.description: The schema documents of the project's persistence. Declare it only if the project documents its persistence.

always.description: The limit, set by the owner: the most tokens a bounded context may load before any of its code is read. budget.mjs measures each bounded context (every-session files + its spec + its area file + its scoped rules) and compares each one to this limit on its own, not their maximum or mean: over it, the report says OVER and --check fails. The script never changes this value; the owner adjusts it after an assessment. A plan larger than it is flagged 'never read whole'. Default 32000.

chars_per_token.description: Characters per estimated token, above 0. Default 4.

review.description: When the assessment is held, e.g. quarterly, every six sprints.

id.description: The name of the bounded context.

area.description: Its area; leave it out for a bounded context in no area.

spec.description: The folder that holds spec.md. Leave it out for the default <specs>/<area>/<id>, or <specs>/<id> in no area; set it only to point elsewhere, outside this repository for example.

code.description: Globs of its code. They decide which scoped rules apply; the code is not counted.

hexagons.description: The hexagons of the bounded context, each with its form and its layer map.

form.description: thin: no domain layer. rich: a domain layer.

reason.description: Why this form. A form with no reason is not a decision.

layers.description: Each layer of the hexagon and the glob of its files. The names are the project's.

allowed.description: The dependencies allowed between layers, as "from -> to". Whatever is not here is forbidden.
